name: 履歴と分類を備えたページ移動パレット
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted correction of LH07-0068. Image1 ORIGINAL source is authority for icon geometry and fine control anatomy. Image2 is the previous generated edit target. Image3 is secondary mock for locked Japanese typography and content. Official pure-white/forest-green/slate design remains binding.
Edit the latest palette with three related compact-layout corrections only. 1) Original switch-organization icon has UPPER arrow pointing LEFT, LOWER arrow pointing RIGHT. Reverse the two arrow directions to that original mapping. 2) Remove the inner rounded search-field rectangle; make the search a flat32high header with only a bottom hairline, as original source. Keep search glyph/text unchanged. 3) Reduce vertical section whitespace and outer top/bottom padding so card height falls about10percent, from510 to460logical px at420width. Preserve all twelve item rows at28high and same14px/24 text; take space from group gaps/header/footer padding, never shrink text. ALL21 existing Japanese text blocks, footer4 groups/count14, keycaps, all other source icon shapes and positions remain intact. Footer fonts12/16 and complete. No new copy/icons/selection/color. White palette, small8corners, subtle border/shadow. Avoid font or icon changes outside switch arrows.
reviewNotes: 上下矢印と検索内枠/余白は改善、全文維持。ただし全11固有行アイコンと履歴時計が粗いモックの書類へ退行。受入不可。拡大原画とv1を実参照に加え粗いモックを外す新しい限定修正を行う。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
